name: Nasreen Begum
title: Community Rights Organiser
description: She knows exactly which forms to file. The system knows exactly how to ignore them.
backstory: Nasreen runs a one-woman community helpdesk in Metiabruz, helping families navigate eviction notices, ration card applications, and police complaints. She has no funding, no office, and no formal authority — just an encyclopaedic knowledge of local bureaucracy and a reputation that means people walk three kilometres to find her. She's been labelled a 'troublemaker' by the local ward office and a 'community asset' by an NGO that published her in a report and gave her nothing.
traitInteractions: Combination of high empathy and high analyticity means she diagnoses systemic causes where others see individual failures
Social orientation drives her — isolation is genuinely harmful to her functioning
Her principled action scores high but she knows when the battle isn't worth the cost
strengths: Deep institutional knowledge of KMC and welfare systems
vulnerabilities: Marked as a threat by local political machine
Personal financial situation precarious despite helping others

socialContext.communityIdentity: Bengali Muslim minority, Metiabruz, women's rights, community organiser
politicalPressures: Post-CAA environment means minority identity is politicised and surveilled
Police routinely discourage her from filing complaints on behalf of clients
Labelled 'politically motivated' by ward office to delegitimise her work
hiddenObligations: Supporting her brother's family after he lost his job — not known publicly
Promised a widow she'd get her son's case reopened; has been unable to
Afraid that visibility will make her a target; tries to stay under the radar while doing loud work
insightLines: Nasreen's willingness to act despite personal cost is not recklessness — it is a calculated bet that the community matters more than her comfort.
She chose principle over self-preservation because she has seen what happens when no one does.
Her distrust of institutions isn't cynicism; it is documented, evidence-based, and entirely correct.
socialContext.dilemmaProfile: Principled action dominant; will sacrifice personal gain for community; rarely self-interested
